selections.intent:
This billing report is wrong in two places.

  1. A reading's billed amount is meant to be its volume multiplied by its unit cost, not added to it.
  2. `with_surcharge` is supposed to add a 3 unit surcharge to every amount, but it currently leaves the amounts alone.

Fix both, checking the value after each fix so you can see the effect of the change you just made. When both are fixed, say DONE and stop.
Inspect billed and with_surcharge definitions and their downstream bindings so each requested correction can be made and its resulting value checked immediately.
Check whether billed's definition was actually replaced, and expose its input/helper definitions to make the requested multiplication and probe verification precise.
Expand readings, volume, cost, billed, and with_surcharge definitions to inspect tuple representation, current implementations, and available report values before completing the two fixes.
Expand the relevant bindings, especially billed's type and any map helper, and inspect target/total so the per-fix value checks can use the report's real output.
Reveal readings, volume, cost, from_station, and billed definitions; billed is still a typed hole, so inspect the actual available map/helper syntax and input data before defining it.

Expose billed, with_surcharge, target, and total definitions; billed remains a hole after previous edits, so need the current structural content and report dependencies to complete the fixes and check values.
Inspect the hidden readings tuple fields and helpers so billed multiplication can be implemented correctly, and determine the actual target report values for checking each fix.

Reveal the collapsed implementations of station, from_station, subtotal, and with_surcharge so the billing fixes can use existing function semantics and probes can check the report value after each change.
Expand the definitions of readings, volume, cost, and target so billed can be implemented using the actual tuple selectors and checked on the real target data.
Expand from_station, subtotal, with_surcharge, target, and total to inspect exact report flow and current surcharge behavior before applying each fix and checking the resulting value.

edits.intent: Map each reading tuple to volume(r) multiplied by cost(r), replacing the current addition.
Define billed by mapping over rows and returning volume(r) * cost(r) for each row.
Implement recursive mapping by matching rows: [] returns []; (station_id, v, c) :: tail returns (v * c) :: billed(tail).
Replace the hole with a recursive function: case rows of [] => []; ((station_id, v, c) :: tl) => (v * c) :: billed(tl). Use Hazel case branches and end.
Implement billed recursively: case rows | [] => [] | (station_id, v, c) :: tail => (v * c) :: billed(tail) end. This maps each reading to volume times unit cost.
Replace billed's definition with fun rows -> case rows | [] => [] | (station, v, unit_cost) :: tail => (v * unit_cost) :: billed(tail) end. Return a list of products, recursively.
Implement billed as map(rows, fun r -> volume(r) * cost(r)), so every reading's billed amount is its volume multiplied by its unit cost.
Define billed recursively over rows. Match [] and return []. Match (station_id, v, c) :: tail and return (v * c) :: billed(tail), so each bill is volume times unit cost.
Map each row to its billed amount by returning volume(r) * cost(r), replacing the addition.
Set the function body to map(rows, fun r -> volume(r) * cost(r)).
Replace the existing billed definition with map(rows, fun r -> volume(r) * cost(r)). Keep the map over readings and multiply volume by unit cost.
Replace the right-hand-side definition with the expression: fun rows -> map(rows, fun r -> volume(r) * cost(r)). This computes each row's volume times its unit cost.
Define billed recursively: case rows | [] => [] | (station_id, v, c) :: tail => (v * c) :: billed(tail) end. This calculates volume times unit cost for each reading.
Definition expression is a function taking rows; return map(rows, fun r -> volume(r) * cost(r)). Use the existing map and tuple selector functions.

task_prompts.fix-middle:
This billing report is wrong in two places.

  1. A reading's billed amount is meant to be its volume multiplied by its unit cost, not added to it.
  2. `with_surcharge` is supposed to add a 3 unit surcharge to every amount, but it currently leaves the amounts alone.

Fix both, checking the value after each fix so you can see the effect of the change you just made. When both are fixed, say DONE and stop.
task_prompts.nav-fleet:
This fleet telematics report is wrong in three places.

  1. Fuel is being billed on the distance driven. It should be billed on the litres the vehicle actually burned.
  2. Drivers are penalised for every idle minute. Only idle minutes beyond the idle allowance should be penalised.
  3. The service flag is inverted: a vehicle is due for service once its total distance has reached the service interval, not while it is still below it.

The program is large and organised into modules; find the definitions responsible before editing. Check the program's value after each fix. When every fix is in and the program evaluates cleanly, say DONE and stop.
